inputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.constructor.session
inputs.description: The project session used to read the registry, inspect the selected project, and open projects. This is a ProjectSessionService instance.

inputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.constructor.outbox
inputs.description: The outbox that persists pending comment drafts and lists them for the selected project. Defaults to session.outbox when omitted.

inputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.selectProject.input
inputs.description: Identifies a registered local project by the ID used by ProjectRegistryService. If the project is already selected and no switch is underway, the service returns its current snapshot.

inputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.capabilities.input
inputs.description: Provides an optional project ID for checking the selected project's context. Defaults to {}; omitting projectId leaves the current selection check unchanged.

inputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.addComment.input
inputs.description: Carries requestId, a revision anchor, and comment text; projectId and threadId are optional. The project discussion entity must have no thread or visual anchor details, while other anchors are checked against the project catalog.

inputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.pendingComments.input
inputs.description: Provides an optional project ID for checking the selected project's context. Defaults to {}; omitting projectId leaves the current selection check unchanged.

outputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.listProjects
outputs.description: Returns the registered local projects from session.registry.list(). Each item has a local- ID containing the SHA-256 of its canonical root, its basename, kind local, and the root path; invalid registry data rejects.

outputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.selectProject
outputs.description: Resolves to the project snapshot from session.snapshot() or session.open(). An already selected project with no switch in progress is snapshotted using branch null and commit null; otherwise the registered project root is opened.

capabilities.reason: Comments are saved as local pending drafts until connected.

outputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.capabilities
outputs.description: Reports local-project capabilities after checking the requested context and requiring an open project. The returned capabilities currently enable comments, agents, planning, and approval with source local.

examples.reason: Human comments are local pending drafts, not synced.

outputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.addComment
outputs.description: Resolves to the pending comment record saved by the local outbox. Non-discussion anchors are checked against the current revision and catalog, and any referenced image or thread must match.

examples.reason: Saved locally; not synced. Connect a verified shared project to publish.

outputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.pendingComments
outputs.description: Resolves to the selected project's pending local comment records from the outbox. It requires a fully open project and does not publish or sync these drafts.

examples.reason: Saved locally; not synced. Connect a verified shared project to publish.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Methods throw or reject with Error for registry, selection, switching, comment-anchor, and outbox failures. Rejections from the delegated revision, catalog, registry, and storage calls also propagate.

outputs.name: ProjectOperationsService.listProjects

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with Error('Invalid project registry.') when stored registry entries fail local-project validation.
